name: VFW Hall #1138
blurb: Wood paneling, a bar that serves only Coors, and a cage borrowed from a dog breeder.

name: Lucky Buck Casino Ballroom
blurb: Smells like cigarettes and broken dreams. Free buffet for fighters (do not eat the shrimp).

name: Tri-County Fairgrounds Arena
blurb: Shared with a monster truck rally. The cage has tire marks.

name: Bluebonnet Rodeo Pavilion
blurb: Dirt floor, great acoustics, faint smell of bull.

name: State U. Memorial Fieldhouse
blurb: Basketball court with a cage on it. The mascot keeps trying to get in.

name: Harborfront Arena
blurb: A real arena with real seats and a real union crew that hates you.

name: Golden Mirage Events Center
blurb: The fight capital. Whales in front row, Elvis impersonators in the cheap seats.

name: Metropolitan Garden
blurb: The mecca. Selling it out means you've made it. Not selling it out means a hit piece.

name: Thames Dome Arena
blurb: Events at 3am local time so the American TV slot works. The fans are drunk regardless.

name: Arena Carioca do Povo
blurb: The loudest crowd on earth. They will chant death threats at your main event in perfect rhythm.

name: Southern Cross Stadium
blurb: Record crowds, record sunburns, record amounts of beer thrown at the octagon.

name: Fort Liberty-ish Hangar 9
blurb: Troops-only event. Great PR. A colonel will demand a photo op.

name: Skyline Parking Garage Rooftop
blurb: An outdoor event on a rooftop. Wind, helicopters and liability. The influencers love it.

name: Big Oil Bowl
blurb: A stadium show. Nobody in the top deck can see anything. Everyone buys a $19 beer anyway.

name: Royal Qasr Mega-Pavilion
blurb: The Kingdom pays YOU to come. Gold-plated cage. Several human rights groups would like a word.

name: The Orb
blurb: A giant LED sphere the size of God's ego. The walls can show the fighters' search history. Please don't.

name: Strip Mall Fight Pit (Next to a Cash Advance)
blurb: Folding chairs, a cage zip-tied together, and a nail salon sharing the AC.

name: Lucky Strike Lanes & Brawl
blurb: Fights between lanes 6 and 7. Bowling continues during the main event.

name: Uncle Dale's Barn
blurb: Hay bales for seats. A goat watches every fight with judgement.

name: First Baptist Gymnasium
blurb: Pastor insists on a prayer before each round and no cursing (lol).

name: Club Concussion
blurb: Bottle service cageside. The DJ refuses to stop during fights.

name: The Ape-X
blurb: Empty TV studio venue. You can hear every punch, grunt and fart.

name: T-Mobster Arena
blurb: The fight capital's crown jewel. Celebrities cageside pretending to know what a kimura is.

name: Madison Squared Garden
blurb: The world's most famous arena. Costs more than your house. Smells like 1974.

name: Barfclays Center
blurb: Brooklyn hipsters ironically cheering for wrestlers.

name: Crypto.con Arena
blurb: Named after a sponsor that may not exist by fight night.

name: The O-Zone
blurb: London's dome. Fights at 4am so America can watch. The crowd is three pints deep at 9pm.

name: Ethi-Bad Arena
blurb: Fight Island-ish. Gorgeous. Air-conditioned. Ethically air-conditioned.

name: Roger That Place
blurb: Canada! Everyone's polite until the main event.

name: Saitama Super-Duper Arena
blurb: Legendary Japanese arena. Fans politely silent, then lose their minds at a heel hook.

name: Arena Jeunesse-ish
blurb: Rio. The crowd will chant 'you're going to die' at your fighters. Lovingly.

name: Arena Mexico-ish
blurb: Altitude so high your heavyweights gas in 40 seconds.

name: Accor-Dion Arena
blurb: Paris. Fans boo the national anthem of whoever is winning.

name: RAC-ket Arena
blurb: Perth. Middle of the night. Somebody brings a kangaroo.

name: Fight Beach (The Island)
blurb: An actual island. Fighters can't leave. Nobody asks why.

name: State Correctional Yard (Charity Event)
blurb: 'Rehabilitation through violence.' The warden is a big fan.

name: USS Sponsorship (Aircraft Carrier)
blurb: Fights on a flight deck. The Navy wants you to know it's a recruitment opportunity.

name: The Big Lawn (Federal)
blurb: A fight on the lawn of a very important building. Secret Service working the cage door.

name: Royal Caribbean-ish Cruise Deck
blurb: Fights at sea. Norovirus is the real heavyweight champ.

name: Waffle Hut Parking Lot (Midnight)
blurb: Unsanctioned-feeling. Legally sanctioned. Barely.

name: Fight Island (Private Beach Cage)
blurb: A billionaire's private island. A cage on the sand, a resort, a parrot, and jellyfish with opinions.
